title: Repository Governance Manifest
description: Declarative governance boundaries for Agentics platform repositories. Defines which organizations, environments, and roles can access specific repositories and their outputs. This manifest is purely declarative - it expresses intent and access scope without embedding business logic.

id.description: Unique governance manifest identifier (UUID v4, immutable)

repository.description: Repository this governance manifest applies to

organizationId.description: Organization that owns this governance manifest

description.description: Human-readable description of the repository and its governance requirements

executionGovernance.description: Governance rules for who can initiate/execute operations in this repository

outputVisibility.description: Governance rules for who can view outputs from this repository

complianceClassification.description: Compliance classification for this repository's data and outputs

effectiveDate.description: Date when this governance manifest becomes effective

expirationDate.description: Date when this governance manifest expires (null for no expiration)

observedAt.description: When this governance state was observed

dataSource.description: Authoritative source of this governance data

initiatorGrants.description: Access grants for entities that can initiate/execute operations

defaultDeny.description: If true, access is denied unless explicitly granted (recommended)

requiresApproval.description: If true, execution requires additional approval workflow

approverRoles.description: Roles that can approve execution requests (if requiresApproval is true)

liveOutputGrants.description: Access grants for entities that can view live/in-progress outputs (observer role)

completedOutputGrants.description: Access grants for entities that can view completed outputs (read-only role)

sensitiveFieldRedaction.description: JSON paths to fields that should be redacted for lower-privilege viewers

OutputVisibility.description: Governance rules for output visibility (separate from execution authority)

retentionDays.description: Number of days to retain audit logs

immutableAuditTrail.description: Whether audit logs must be stored in an immutable format

realTimeAlerts.description: Whether to generate real-time alerts for audit events
